headline: Anthropic combines Claude chat and Cowork for Enterprise customers
body: Anthropic says it has unified Claude chat and Cowork for its enterprise customers. note: Enterprise organizations can check the rollout in the administration settings before the Nov. 16 default change.

evidence.text: Anthropic says it has unified Claude chat and Cowork for its enterprise customers.
The new offering combines chat and Cowork on web, desktop and mobile, meaning users don’t have to choose between the two services before starting, Anthropic announced Friday (Oct. 23).
The “unified Claude experience” starts as a chat and moves into a Cowork cloud session when a task needs agentic work , and goes back to chat when it doesn’t, the announcement said.
It is turned off by default in existing organizations and is due to turn on by default on Nov. 16, Anthropic added.
According to the announcement, the unified Claude is available on Enterprise plans, where it appears in administration settings as Chat and Cowork unified.
